publication.title: iPhone OS Research Atlas
publication.scope: iPhone OS 1.1.4 / 4A102 and 3.1.3 / 7E18; native PinePhone execution, distinct QEMU gates and offline next-target study
publication.provenance: Original editorial synthesis of private project notebooks and experiment reports, with reviewed capture images, selected source excerpts and their provenance. Firmware, storage images, complete run artifacts and the implementation repository are not included.
publication.author: Felipe Sabino

record.title: 3.1.3 daily use after cold power-on
record.method: Owner hand test, continuous UART, decoded media and complete available-region readback
record.observation: On October 7 the owner accepts battery/charging indication, unlock/touch, Power blank/wake, upright Camera preview, shutter, thumbnail, Photos, complete power-off staying off for 30 seconds and reopening the same new photo after cold power-on.
record.limits: Ordinary stock restart, legacy daily hand checks, USB pairing and stock rotation remain unaccepted by this trial. This does not measure battery endurance or image quality.
